# Voice Pipes

> Ultra-low-latency, modular conversational voice pipeline runtime written in Rust. Glass-to-glass latency under 500ms with swappable STT, TTS, LLM, VAD, and Turn Detection plugins.

Voice Pipes orchestrates full-duplex conversational voice agents. It connects client audio over WebSockets to speech-to-text (STT), text processing (LLM / reasoning), and text-to-speech (TTS), with sub-second real-time turn detection and immediate audio interruption (barge-in).

## Getting Started
- [Quickstart with Docker](docs/getting-started/quickstart-docker.md): 5-minute zero-setup launch with orchestrator, worker, and admin console.
- [First Agent Guide](docs/getting-started/first-agent.md): Configuring personas, voices, and LLMs in TOML.
- [Concepts](docs/getting-started/concepts.md): Core primitives: frames, chunks, turns, pipelines, workers, and orchestrators.
- [Quickstart from Source](docs/getting-started/quickstart-source.md): Native Cargo build on Linux, macOS, and Windows.

## Plugin & Component Development (SDK 1.0)
- [Plugin SDK Guide](docs/extending/plugin-sdk.md): Complete guide to building STT, TTS, LLM, VAD, S2S, and Turn plugins with `voice-pipes-sdk 1.x`.
- [Custom Component Architecture](docs/extending/custom-component.md): Implementing the `Component` trait for health, degraded states, and telemetry.
- [SDK Stability Policy](docs/extending/sdk-stability.md): SemVer guarantees for `voice-pipes-sdk 1.x`.
- [Wizard Descriptor Guide](docs/extending/wizard-descriptor.md): Registering plugins into the interactive CLI setup wizard.

## Provider Integrations
- [Speech-to-Text Providers](docs/guides/providers/stt/): Local ONNX (Parakeet TDT, Nemotron, Moonshine) and Cloud (AssemblyAI, Google Cloud Speech).
- [Text-to-Speech Providers](docs/guides/providers/tts/): Local ONNX (Kokoro, Piper) and Cloud (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Gemini).
- [LLM & Reasoning Processors](docs/guides/providers/llm/): Local GGUF via llama.cpp, OpenAI-compatible APIs (vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio), and gRPC split-mode.
- [Speech-to-Speech Providers](docs/guides/providers/s2s/): Bidirectional streaming with Gemini Live and OpenAI Realtime.

## Architecture & Core Mechanics
- [System Architecture](docs/explanation/architecture.md): Worker, orchestrator, transport, and pipeline execution flow.
- [Interruption & Barge-In Model](docs/explanation/interruption-model.md): How Voice Pipes cancels in-flight LLM tokens and audio playback instantaneously.
- [Composable VAD Engine](docs/explanation/composable-vad.md): Multi-stage voice activity detection with Silero and energy thresholds.
- [Per-Turn Metrics & Observability](docs/explanation/per-turn-metrics.md): Millisecond latency breakdowns across every pipeline stage.

- [WebSocket Protocol](docs/clients/protocol.md): Binary audio framing and JSON control protocol specification.
